title: Localized cocones without finiteness or transition tensor hypotheses
statement: Let R→S be commutative rings and M an S-module with the restricted R-action [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let a nonempty directed preorder index compatible diagrams A→B and D of modules, with supplied colimit cocones to the common-universe ULifts of R,S,M [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-directed-colimit-abelian-groups]. No Noetherianity, finiteness or transition tensor hypothesis is imposed. For a prime q of S, there exist local ring diagrams A^l,B^l and a module diagram D^l, with colimits and compatible localized scalar actions. Their base-to-top and transition ring maps are local and their module transitions and coprojections are semilinear. There is a commuting colimit map ψ. The base colimit is the localization R_(q∩R) and its module colimit is R-linearly equivalent to M_q. Each base stage is A_i localized at the contraction of q and its module is A_i-linearly equivalent to (D_i)_(q_i). In addition, there are numerator maps ρA_i,ρB_i,ζ_i, natural in transitions and commuting with A_i→B_i and the localized stage map. With the algebras induced by ρA_i and ρB_i, the stage rings satisfy IsLocalization at the respective contracted prime complements. The ζ_i are semilinear and their associated B_i-linear maps into D^l_i with action restricted through ρB_i satisfy IsLocalizedModule at q_i [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime, def-weil-pbc-module-localization].

proof.text: Use the explicit primeRingDiagram, primeModuleDiagram and primeDiagramHom from LocalizedApproximationColimits. Contract q through ULift.down. Naturality of the original cocones identifies the contracted primes along transitions. These constructions have actual fraction maps and proved functor laws; they choose no data from an existence theorem.

Apply localized_approximation_colimits to the common-universe ULifts and the supplied colimit witnesses, commuting square and scalar identities. This supplies ψ, the top-colimit module action, the coprojection equation and semilinearity. Apply canonical_localized_approximation_limit to these very ψ and action and these two identities, obtaining the base localization witness and the R-linear comparison with M_q.

Prime localizations are local by the Mathlib instance. Localization.isLocalHom_localRingHom proves locality of every stage and transition ring map. primeDiagramHom_naturality proves the commuting squares; primeModuleMap_smul proves localized transition semilinearity.

Take every ρA and ρB to be the canonical algebraMap and every ζ to be LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap as an additive map. Reassociate Ideal.comap to identify the displayed primes with those of the explicit diagrams. The canonical localization instances prove both IsLocalization witnesses. localRingHom_to_map proves the ring numerator squares and naturality; primeModuleMap_mk at denominator one proves ζ naturality, and algebraMap_smul with mkLinearMap.map_smul proves numerator semilinearity. At a stage the original restricted A_i action equals the action restricted through A_i→(A_i)_p→(B_i)_q, by localRingHom_to_map and algebraMap_smul. Transport the identity linear equivalence along this proved Module equality. Finally the B_i action restricted through ρB equals the canonical action; transport localizedModuleIsLocalizedModule and the numerator-one linear map through this Module equality. All these transports are proved by private helpers, with no new holes.
